verdict.rationale: GitHub exposes a REST/GraphQL API and could plausibly offer an interactive reference with runnable examples, but the evidence pack contains no such documentation—only permission-header docs (github-docs-18/19) and a probe showing no discoverable OpenAPI spec (github-probe-2, all endpoints 404). No mention of a 'try it' console, live runnable code samples, or interactive explorer exists in the pack.
